strategy.offer: Traditional bakery and confectionery goods, including breads, cakes, cookies, seasonal holiday pastries, regional gift assortments, online ordering, and catered event or meeting services.
strategy.customers: Households buying everyday or seasonal baked goods, gift purchasers, nearby retail shoppers, online buyers, and families or companies needing event space and catering.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects success from combining traditional recipes, skilled handcraft, trusted quality, largely regional ingredients, and convenient access through local outlets and home ordering.
strategy.resources: Its basis is baking and confectionery know-how, long experience, established recipes, manual production, production facilities, local outlets, an online shop, and regional supplier relationships.
